# Enum Select

## Summary
A closed list of values edited in place, built on boxel-ui's `BoxelSelect` so it takes the same theme tokens as every other control on the row (a native `<select>` is the one element a theme cannot reach).

## API
Args: `label`, `value?`, `options: string[]`, `emptyLabel?`, `onChange(value | undefined)`, `disabled?`.

## Usage
```ts
import { EnumSelect } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/service-desk/components/enum-select';

<EnumSelect @label='Priority' @value={{this.priority}} @options={{this.priorities}} @onChange={{this.setPriority}} />
```
Pairs with Link Picker, which does the same job for fields whose value is a card rather than a word.

## Non-goals
Not a field: it edits a value the caller stores. No search or free text — for open vocabularies use a text input.
attributes.cardDescription: A themed closed-list picker for one-word values, the counterpart of Link Picker for card values.
